combining improved complementary feeding and water, sanitation and hygienic interventions significantly improved motor and language development in HIV exposed uninflected children in rural Zimbabwe, but not cognitive development or self control.

combining improved complementary feeding and WASH interventions had a significant impact on motor, language, and cognitive development in 24-month-old HIV-exposed children in rural Zimbabwe, but there was no significant impact of either of the individual interventions.

combined interventions to improve IYCF and water, sanitation and hand washing significantly improved ECD outcomes in HIV exposed children, but that neither IYCF nor WASH alone had a significant effect on ECD.
